text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: widespread VPC egress failures in us-west-1 impacting hosted API calls to external telemetry & artifact endpoints. Auto-alert triggered for outbound error-rate > 5%. Paging oncall.
riley_oncall: seeing 502/504s for calls to telemetry.redwood.external and artifact fetches failing with TLS handshake errors. Kicking off network checks.
tasha_sre: quick health check: `curl -v https://telemetry.redwood.external` from bastion returns `TLS handshake timeout`. Tcpdump shows SYN retries to gateway IP.
vlad_infra: checking VPC NAT gateway and route tables. NAT gateway healthy but our egress ENI pool is exhausted due to sticky connections from a recent rollout of the telemetry agent. Spawning replacement ENIs and rotating agent canaries.
maia_prod: status page up: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1772009999  Impact: increased latency and errors for hosted API calls that rely on external telemetry and artifact services in us-west-1. Mitigation in progress.
cs_rep: we've received multiple customer reports citing timeouts during uploads; sharing status page and offering to retry/resubmit jobs.
riley_oncall: temporarily redirect artifact fetches to cached S3 mirror for hosted pools to reduce external egress. Enabling on canary cluster now.
tasha_sre: identified surge in long-lived TLS sessions created by telemetry-agent v2.3.0 which pins sockets and prevents ENI reuse. Rolling back to v2.2.1 on canaries.
vlad_infra: ENI rotation in progress; added 50% more ephemeral ENI capacity and adjusted idle-socket timeout on the NAT layer from 15m -> 60s to free sockets faster.
maia_prod: status note: "Partial mitigation: TRT (traffic redirect) to cached artifacts and telemetry-agent rollback on canaries; ENI capacity increased. Monitoring." Draft customer advisory created: https://docs.google.com/draft/incident-1772009999 (internal).
cs_rep: proactively notifying impacted customers about mitigation and expected 30-60m recovery window.
riley_oncall: after rollback and ENI rotation, artifact fetch success rate recovered to baseline on canaries within 2m. Rolling changes to remaining pools.
tasha_sre: root cause candidate: telemetry-agent v2.3.0 uses a pooled async client that leaks TLS sessions under high-concurrency upload patterns. Repro steps created in infra repo.
vlad_infra: follow-ups: 1) add ENI exhaustion alert (available_ips < 15% for 3min), 2) add NAT idle-socket tuning as a runbook item, 3) add canary gate for telemetry-agent rollouts that validates socket churn.
maia_prod: status update: "Recovered: mitigations applied and service traffic returned to normal; monitoring for 1h." Customer advisory sent.
cs_rep: no data lost; customers confirmed degraded UX only.
legal: any regulatory customers impacted? CS says two compliance customers briefly affected; collecting details.
maia_prod: postmortem owner assigned: tasha_sre. Action items created in PM: https://redwood.internal/pm/1772009999-postmortem
incident_bot: RESOLVED signal at 1772011200  Incident closed.
